note: Add the new lifecycle verb as a first-positional command with help and a single-source synopsis, and keep the upgrade design of GitHub fetch, sha256 verify, atomic same-dir rename, and skill refresh via the new binary.

Build on the incremental validation slice (redo-log cursor, touched-entity classification) and per-kind re-checks, keeping the composite smallest-bucket probe and the commit-time uniqueness map consistent.

Extend the store-level databases catalog (currently three fixed namespaces) and update the single-database assumptions in dbms.info and SHOW DATABASES, noting that the CIP-170 Enterprise scenarios are frozen out.
Amend ADR-0068's hosting, platform and invocation decisions, keeping the GITHUB_TOKEN-on-bash pipe rule, SHA256SUMS verification, and parity with the upgrade command's platform scope.

Tighten the same-clause self-reference rejection for CREATE/INSERT, keeping the comprehension-shadowing and earlier-clause exceptions, and note that ADR-0584 removes the version-gated arm so the rule is now unconditional.

Add the event under the CYPHERLITE-CLI_ prefix with no query text, paths or parameter values, and deliver it by spooling locally at exit and draining on the next enabled run, which replaces ADR-0079's in-run channel and thread.
